sources.snippet: Intern-S2-Mobius is a 35B foundation model published by internlm, the Hugging Face organization behind Shanghai AI Laboratory's Intern series. The weights landed on Hugging Face on July 29, 2026, and the accompanying GitHub repository — README, deployment guide, and a full technical report PDF — went public on August 5, 2026.
